list.title: From your teacher
list.subtitle: Assessments your teacher set for your groups.
list.emptyBody: When your teacher publishes an assessment for your group, it appears here.
list.intro1: Leaving this tab or window, leaving full screen, and losing your connection are recorded and shown to your teacher.
list.intro2: These are signals for your teacher to look at, not proof of anything.
list.intro3: Your device is not locked. You can still switch away, and each time you do, it is noted.
list.intro4: Your answers are saved as you choose them. The exam starts when you press the button.
list.intro4Timed: Your answers are saved as you choose them. The {minutes}-minute timer starts when you press the button.

errors.READMIT_REQUIRED: Your teacher needs to let you back in. Ask them to readmit you.
errors.GENERIC: Couldn’t start the exam. Try again in a minute.

missing.title: This exam isn’t available
missing.body: The link may be old, or the exam belongs to another account.

signal.warning: That was counted as a signal for your teacher.
signal.flagged: Your attempt was flagged for review.

Exam.keyboardHint: Keys: up and down arrows move between options, Space or Enter selects, number keys pick an option.

paused.title: The exam is paused
paused.body: Your teacher paused the exam. Wait until they resume it. Your answers are saved.

confirm.title: Submit your answers?
confirm.bodyAll: You answered all {total} questions. You can’t change them after you submit.
confirm.bodySome: You left {count} without an answer. You can’t change answers after you submit.
confirm.error: Couldn’t submit. Your answers are saved. Try again in a minute.

sync.offline: Offline. Answers are sent when you’re back online.

note.EXPIRED: Time ran out. Your saved answers were scored.
note.ENDED: Your teacher ended the exam. Your saved answers were scored.

result.hidden: Your teacher chose not to show the correct answers.

policy.sentence: Signal {warn}: a warning. Signal {notify}: the teacher is notified. From signal {act}: the attempt is {action}. {reentry}
policy.reentryYes: Coming back after a disconnect is allowed.
policy.reentryNo: Coming back after a disconnect needs the teacher’s permission.

missing.title: Assessment not found
missing.body: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another teacher.

ExamLive.subtitle: {group} · {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}
ExamLive.actionError: The action didn’t go through. Try again in a minute.
ExamLive.empty: No students in this group yet.

warn.title: Warn {name}
warn.label: Message to the student
warn.defaultMessage: Please return to the exam window and keep working.

reset.title: Reset {name}’s attempt?
reset.body: This clears their answers and lets them start again. It can’t be undone.

end.title: End {name}’s attempt?
end.body: Their saved answers are scored now and they can’t continue.

kind.FOCUS_LOST: left the exam tab or window
kind.APP_BACKGROUND: moved the app to the background

ExamLive.signalsNote: Signals show what a device reported. They are for you to review, not proof, and devices are not locked.
